extensionDescription.message: Delays video by the PodBridge audio latency while it streams to HomePod, so lips and sound line up.

fineTuneHint.message: Move right if the picture is ahead of the sound, left if it lags behind.

drmHint.message: Browsers do not allow delaying protected (DRM) video such as Netflix.

notStreaming.message: PodBridge is open but not streaming to a HomePod. Video plays normally.

delaying.message: $DEVICE$ is playing. Video is delayed by $MS$ ms.
